when one is asleep and awake.definitionKo: 잠들어 있을 때나 깨어 있을 때나 늘.
when one is asleep and awake.englishDescription: Always, whenever one is asleep or awake.
when one is asleep and awake.englishExpression: when one is asleep and awake
matchedEnglishExpressions: when one is asleep and awake

white heat.definitionKo: 물체가 흰색에 가까운 빛을 낼 정도로 온도가 매우 높은 상태나 그 열.
white heat.englishDescription: A state in which the temperature of a thing is high enough to give off white light, or such a heat.

whole area.englishDescription: The whole of a certain area or region.

wild plain.definitionKo: 끝이 보이지 않을 만큼 넓고 큰 벌판.
wild plain.englishDescription: A wide and large plain that seems to be endless.

wind and wave.englishDescription: A strong wind and rough waves.

without effort.definitionKo: 무거운 물건을 아주 가볍고 쉽게 들어 올리는 모양.
without effort.englishDescription: In the manner of lifting something heavy very lightly and easily.

without reason.definitionKo: 미리 허락을 받거나 알림 없이. 또는 아무 이유 없이.
without reason.englishDescription: Without getting permission or notifying in advance;  without any reason.
without reason.englishExpression: without permission; without notice; without reason

woodblock.definitionKo: 인쇄를 하기 위해서 글이나 그림을 새긴 나무 판.
woodblock.englishDescription: A block of wood where texts or images are carved for printing.

woodcraft.definitionKo: 나무로 만든 아름다운 작품이나 실용적인 물건. 또는 그런 가공 기술.
woodcraft.englishDescription: A beautiful work of art or practical object made from wood, or such a skill.

work of nature.definitionKo: 하늘과 땅이 일으키는 여러 가지 신비스러운 일.
work of nature.englishDescription: The mysterious things heaven and earth bring into being.

writing contest.englishDescription: A writing contest held by the government or an organization.

wrong refereeing.englishDescription: The act of judging wrongly, or a wrong judgment.

yama.definitionKo: 불교에서, 죽은 사람이 살아 있을 때 한 일의 잘잘못을 심판하는 저승 세계의 왕.
yama.englishDescription: The king of the underworld in Buddhism who judges the right and wrong of the actions a dead person did when he/she was alive.

yes.definitionKo: 윗사람의 부름에 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers the call of his/her elder.

yes.definitionKo: 윗사람의 물음이나 명령 등에 긍정하여 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker affirmatively answers the call or order of his/her superior.

yes.definitionKo: 회의 등에서 어떤 안건에 대해 표결을 할 때 찬성한다는 표시.
yes.englishDescription: An expression indicating one's agreement when voting for a certain proposal, as in a meeting.

yes.definitionKo: 상대방의 부름에 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers someone's call.

yes.definitionKo: 상대방의 물음이나 명령 등에 긍정하여 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker gives an affirmative answer to someone's question, order, etc.

yes.definitionKo: 서로를 격려하며 다같이 힘을 모아 싸울 때 내는 소리.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when people encourage each other to gather strength for a fight.

yes.definitionKo: 아랫사람의 부름에 대답할 때 하는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers the call of someone junior to him/her.

yes.definitionKo: 아랫사람의 물음이나 부탁에 긍정하여 대답할 때 하는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers in the affirmative to the question or request of someone junior to him/her.

annotations: 주로 나이가 비슷한 사람이나 아랫사람에게 쓴다.
yes.definitionKo: 질문에 되묻거나 옳다고 인정할 때 하는 말.
yes.englishDescription: An exclamation as a way of asking the addressee to repeat his/her question or replying affirmatively to a question.

youngest son.definitionKo: 아들딸 가운데 맨 나중에 낳아 나이가 가장 어린 아들.
youngest son.englishDescription: The youngest son born last among all sons and daughters.

zoo.definitionKo: 여러 동물들을 가두어 기르면서 사람들이 구경할 수 있도록 해 놓은 곳.
zoo.englishDescription: A place that cages and raises all kinds of animals and allows people to look at them.

zoo.definitionKo: 많은 사람들이 모여 여러 종류의 물건을 무질서하게 사고파는 시끄럽고 어수선한 시장.
zoo.englishDescription: A noisy, chaotic market bustling with many people selling and buying a variety of things in a disheveled manner.
